fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSMC) declined 9.5% from $352.09 to $318.71 on November 20, recording 20.1% weekly decline, though October revenue up 59.7% year-over-year still showing growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Historically, TSMC stock has declined first followed by revenue deterioration, with precedent: 60.3% decline in 2001, 29.9% in 2008, and 26.1% in 2023 before subsequent revenue weakness emerged.
